'''Trace ''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he discovered [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] spying on the Imperial communications and asked a passerby to deal with the problem.
